notes: Multi-agency semantic bridge connecting BCA Accessibility Code 2025 v1.1, SCDF Fire Code 2023 (7 Jul 2026), and BCA Approved Document V7.08 provisions to verified CORENET X IFC+SG entities, *USERDEFINED subtypes, and SGPset_* properties.

ifc_entities.label: IFC+SG Accessible Space, Lobbies & Escape Corridors (BCA & SCDF)

property_sets.purpose: Official CORENET X multi-agency space classification flags (BCA accessibility + SCDF fire protection/ventilation/exits).
Accessible route width (BCA) and space area/height.
Cross-agency sanitary appliance flags spanning BCA, PUB (WELS), and NEA.
Wash basin mounting type (NEA).

ifc_entities.label: IFC+SG Door — Accessible & Fire Exit Doors (BCA, SCDF, NEA)

property_sets.purpose: Official CORENET X clear door opening width and height (SCDF Clause 2.2.7a >= 850 mm & BCA accessibility).
Multi-agency door flags across BCA, SCDF, and NEA.
Fire exit, fire rating, external, and self-closing flags used by SCDF and BCA.

ifc_entities.label: IFC+SG Fire Alarm & Visual Warning Devices (SCDF) + BCA Assistance Alarm

property_sets.purpose: Official SCDF IfcAlarm subtype mapping (*VISUALALARM for visual fire warnings in toilets/lobbies/car parks).

ifc_entities.label: IFC+SG Ramp & Exit Ramp (BCA, SCDF, LTA)

property_sets.purpose: Official CORENET X ramp gradient and clear width parameters across all agencies.
BCA accessibility flag plus LTA vehicular/accessway flags.
Official BCA railing height dimension.
Official BCA safety barrier classification and laminated glass indicator.
Identifies SCDF designated exit staircases.
Stair flight tread length on decomposed IfcStairFlight elements.

ifc_entities.label: IFC+SG Compartment, Separating & External Walls (SCDF & BCA)

property_sets.purpose: External wall flag (CORENET X) and IFC4 fire compartmentation/rating metadata.
Wall thickness dimension.
BCA structural and shelter wall properties.
Official SCDF fire rating on fire/smoke dampers penetrating compartment boundaries.

ifc_entities.label: IFC+SG Passenger & Fire Fighting Lifts (SCDF & BCA)

property_sets.purpose: Official SCDF fire fighting lift classification and lift type.
Official CORENET X lift car internal clear dimensions (used by both SCDF Fire Lift and BCA Accessible Lift checks).

checks.title: Larger Accessible Individual Washroom (LWC) clear internal dimensions
checks.applies_when: Where LWC is triggered (e.g., Clause 5.1.3(d) place of worship at every level with toilets; check SGPset_Space.LargerAccessible = TRUE).
checks.measurement_basis: Filter IfcSpace where SGPset_Space.LargerAccessible = TRUE, then measure minimum clear internal width x depth between finished wall faces unobstructed by door swing (verify against Figure 44, p. 65).
checks.open_evidence_if_unmodeled: Dimensioned 1:50 architectural toilet plan and IfcSpace clear-zone geometry linked by GlobalId.

checks.title: Standard Accessible Individual Washroom (AWC) clear internal dimensions
checks.applies_when: Every toilet cluster where toilets are provided (Clause 5.1.1, p. 61; check SGPset_Space.BarrierFreeAccessibility = TRUE and Clause 5.1.2/5.6 cubicle substitution).
checks.measurement_basis: Minimum clear internal width x depth between finished faces of IfcSpace.
checks.open_evidence_if_unmodeled: Dimensioned 1:50 architectural plan and IfcSpace internal boundary geometry.

checks.title: WC fixture centreline, rear distance, transfer zone, and seat height
checks.applies_when: IfcSanitaryTerminal (*WATERCLOSET) with SGPset_SanitaryTerminal.BarrierFreeAccessibility = TRUE inside an accessible washroom or WC cubicle.
checks.measurement_basis: 3D placement of IfcSanitaryTerminal (*WATERCLOSET) relative to adjacent wall face, rear wall face, and IfcBuildingStorey FFL.
checks.open_evidence_if_unmodeled: Sanitary fixture elevation/plan details and manufacturer cut-sheet.

checks.title: Wash basin wall centreline and rim height AFFL
checks.applies_when: IfcSanitaryTerminal (WASHHANDBASIN) inside an accessible individual washroom or accessible toilet cluster.
checks.measurement_basis: 3D placement of IfcSanitaryTerminal (WASHHANDBASIN): centreline to side wall, top rim AFFL, and non-obstruction of WC transfer space.
checks.open_evidence_if_unmodeled: Internal washroom elevation drawing and sanitaryware schedule.

checks.title: Emergency assistance alarm activation control mounting height & reach to WC
checks.applies_when: Accessible individual washrooms (including LWC) and accessible changing rooms.
checks.measurement_basis: Mounting elevation AFFL of push-button/pull-cord (400-600 mm) and horizontal distance from WC pan front/side edge (150-300 mm, p. 83).
checks.open_evidence_if_unmodeled: ELV layout & internal elevation showing alarm control position relative to WC.

checks.title: Emergency assistance alarm waterproof rating, colour contrast, call sign, and receiving destination
checks.applies_when: When emergency assistance alarm is required.
checks.measurement_basis: Waterproof rating, visual contrast against wall finish, adjacent 'Emergency Call' sign, outside indicator, and wired connection to management office / FCC / caregiver's office.
checks.open_evidence_if_unmodeled: ELV device cut-sheet, finish/signage schedule, and cause-and-effect wiring diagram.

checks.title: Visual fire warning device inside toilet / full-height cubicle
checks.applies_when: Building protected by a fire alarm system (check SGPset_Space.FireDetectionAndSuppressionSystem), in isolated spaces including toilets, full-height cubicles, car parks, and lift lobbies.
checks.measurement_basis: Verify presence of IfcAlarm with SubType *VISUALALARM contained inside the washroom IfcSpace (distinct from BCA assistance alarm).
checks.open_evidence_if_unmodeled: Fire alarm building protection trigger confirmation, electrical fire alarm layout, and cubicle partition height.

checks.title: Escape-route minor level change ramp gradient & uniform slope between landings
checks.applies_when: Escape route for persons with disabilities with a minor level change within a storey (verify SCDF 2.4.1a exemptions) and any IfcRamp with SGPset_Ramp.BarrierFreeAccessibility = TRUE.
checks.measurement_basis: Check SGPset_RampDimension.Gradient & Width AND verify total vertical rise, horizontal run, uniform slope across each flight, and top/bottom/intermediate landings against BCA Table 4 (PDF p. 43).
checks.open_evidence_if_unmodeled: Ramp section/plan with spot levels, rise/run dimensions, landing geometry, and escape route classification.

checks.title: Accessible doorway clear opening width along route / washroom entrance
checks.applies_when: Doors along accessible routes and accessible individual washrooms (verify exact clause & figure in BCA 2025 v1.1).
checks.measurement_basis: Read SGPset_DoorDimension.ClearWidth and SGPset_Door.PowerOperated, and cross-check clear leaf opening width from IfcDoor geometry.
checks.open_evidence_if_unmodeled: Door schedule linked to IfcDoor GlobalId and clear opening leaf detail.

checks.title: Exit door minimum clear width and fire-rated door attributes on escape routes
checks.applies_when: Exit doors and exit access doors along means of escape (Pset_DoorCommon.FireExit = TRUE).
checks.measurement_basis: Check SGPset_DoorDimension.ClearWidth >= 850 mm (and Table 2.2A for occupant load), plus Pset_DoorCommon.FireRating, SelfClosing, and SGPset_Door.OneWayLockingDevice.
checks.open_evidence_if_unmodeled: Fire safety door schedule linked to IfcDoor GlobalId and escape capacity calculations.

checks.title: Exit staircase designation, enclosure, and flight tread width
checks.applies_when: Protected internal/external exit staircases serving escape routes.
checks.measurement_basis: Verify Pset_StairCommon.FireExit = TRUE, Pset_StairFlightCommon.TreadLength, and staircase clear width against SCDF Table 2.2A.
checks.open_evidence_if_unmodeled: Staircase plans/sections with clear width between handrails and enclosure wall fire rating.

checks.title: Fire / smoke damper fire rating at compartment wall penetrations
checks.applies_when: Ducts penetrating fire-rated compartment walls, compartment floors, or protected shafts.
checks.measurement_basis: Verify IfcDamper (FIREDAMPER / FIRESMOKEDAMPER) has SGPset_Damper.FireRating matching the penetrated compartment barrier.
checks.open_evidence_if_unmodeled: M&E ductwork penetration schedule and fire compartmentation drawings.

checks.title: Fire fighting lift designation and internal car clear dimensions
checks.applies_when: Buildings requiring a fire lift under SCDF Fire Code Chapter 6 and/or accessible passenger lift under BCA Code.
checks.measurement_basis: Check SGPset_TransportElement.FireFightingLift, LiftType, and SGPset_TransportElementDimension.ClearWidth / ClearDepth / ClearHeight.
checks.open_evidence_if_unmodeled: Lift specification schedule, lift shaft plans, and fire lift lobby layout.
